verdict.rationale: Honcho's own docs say the open-source core can be self-hosted so you keep data on your own infrastructure (honcho-docs-9). `honcho start` runs the API, Postgres and Redis locally via Docker (honcho-docs-10), and the MCP server can also run locally instead of on mcp.honcho.dev (honcho-docs-16). That gives full control over where data lives, but only by running it yourself; there is no evidence that the hosted service lets you pick a region. missing for 10: region selection on the managed cloud, documented data-residency or compliance commitments, independent corroboration of self-hosted residency control.
